profile.summary:
I design and build new and cool things, one keystroke at a time.  I am a software developer experienced with frontend development frameworks, UI/UX design, and the ServiceNow platform.  I am strongly interested in the JAMstack in general and am looking forward to new technologies and trends in the industry.

Feel free to contact me through LinkedIn or directly at jeremiah.rey.perez@gmail.com.
